description: Shinero Ultimate Shine & Shield 10-in-1 Car Care Kit | 2L Gloss Pro Shampoo, Sheen Flex Polish, Ultra Wax, Plastic Restorer, Foam Applicator, 1600 GSM & 350 GSM Microfiber Cloths & Car Duster - Distributed/Packaged by Generic. Product Details: Give your car a complete makeover with the Shinero Ultimate Shine & Shield 10-in-1 Kit, a premium detailing package designed for full exterior and interior care. Whether it’s deep cleaning, waxing, polishing, or restoring, this kit has everything you need to achieve a professional-grade finish at home. Why Choose Shinero 10-in-1 Kit? Powerful Car Wash – Two 1L bottles of Gloss Pro Wash & Wax Shampoo provide high-foam cleaning action that removes dirt, grime, and road film while leaving behind a glossy finish. Brilliant Shine & Long Protection – The Ultra Wax (100g) offers a Carnauba-based coating that protects your car’s paint from UV rays, dust, and water spots. Interior & Dashboard Care – Sheen Flex Polish (250ml) revives dashboard and trims, restoring shine while preventing fading and cracking. Plastic Trim Restorer – Restore+ (100ml) brings faded bumpers, trims, and plastic back to life with a rich, restored finish. Premium Accessories – Includes a heavy-duty 1600 GSM microfiber towel for drying, two 350 GSM microfiber cloths for general cleaning, a foam applicator pad for smooth wax/polish application, and a long microfiber duster brush for easy wheel and exterior cleaning. What’s Inside (Set of 10): Gloss Pro Wash & Wax Shampoo – 1L × 2 Sheen Flex All-in-One Dashboard Polish – 250ml Ultra Wax Carnauba – 100g Restore+ Plastic Restorer – 100ml Foam Applicator Pad – 1 Microfiber Cloth – 350 GSM × 2 Microfiber Cloth – 1600 GSM × 1 Long Microfiber Duster Brush – 1 Complete All-Round Car Care Safe on paint, plastic, vinyl, chrome, and glass, the Shinero kit is suitable for cars, SUVs, and bikes. From weekly washes to restoring a showroom shine, this kit makes detailing easy, effective, and professional.
